name: DarkStat
description: Captures network traffic, calculates statistics about usage, and serves reports over HTTP. Configuration /config This is where Darkstat will store it´s database and logs Notes Environment Variables Define the variables, ETH (Match your Unraid interface, don´t use "br0" use eth0, eth1 etc...) PORT (Port for WebUI, if changed don't forget to change it in Additional Fields) IP_HOST (IP of Unraid server) IP_RANGE (IP-range of the local network)
